summary: Busy school-side kerb where cars park; homes about 13 m behind, bus zones nearby.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13 m to 15 m from the section on its own side, with a dwelling 8 m beyond the far end; school and courts opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with a parking lane on this side where several cars are parked, so room to stop exists.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road beside a school and bus route; noise and daytime school traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb in the QLD image, but bus zone and school passenger loading signs sit nearby.

flags: Bus Zone signs close by: check the signed extent
School loading zone 7:30-9:30am and 2-4pm on schooldays
Mapped locked gate 5 m away, with a way round
sun_shade: Street trees on the east side shade the opposite kerb; this kerb is mostly open to the sky.

best_section.where: Swann Road west kerb, opposite the netball courts, north of the church junction
